name: DarkmodeWindow
description: A macOS app that turns anything bright on your screen dark – in any app
run: APP="$HOME/Applications/DarkmodeWindow.app"; if [ -d "$APP" ]; then open "$APP"; else osascript -e 'on run argv' -e 'tell application "Terminal" to activate' -e 'tell application "Terminal" to do script (item 1 of argv)' -e 'end run' -- "cd '$PWD' && ./scripts/build-app.sh && open \"$APP\""; fi
